about.bio:
Mamen Sala is a U.S. correspondent for Mediaset España (Telecinco & Cuatro) and France 24 Spanish, reporting from New York on politics, economics, society, and sports. With over 14 years of experience in audiovisual journalism, she brings expertise in live broadcasting, investigative reporting, video production, and field coverage across two continents.

Beyond the newsroom, Mamen is the co-founder and President of Chef Training U.S., a company connecting hospitality employers in Miami and New York with international talent. She also serves as an Adjunct Professor of Journalism at the Universitat Oberta de Catalunya.

She holds degrees in Mass Communication, Criminology, and Law from the Universitat Internacional de Catalunya and the Universitat Oberta de Catalunya, and a Master's in Marketing from UCLA.
